options.rationale: Canvas apps start from a blank screen layout, not from the data model.

Desktop flows automate legacy UI tasks. They are not apps.

items.stem: Which Power Automate flow type automates clicks in a legacy Windows application with no API?

options.text: Cloud flow with a connector trigger
options.rationale: Cloud flows need connectors or APIs.

Business process flows guide users through stages. They do not automate UI.
A schedule is still a cloud flow and cannot drive a desktop UI.
